title: Martin Marietta launches enhanced digital experience with new company website
summary: Martin Marietta recently debuted a newly designed corporate website focused on delivering an improved user experience.
body_markdown:
In our digital age, your online presence is what creates a first impression for many.


This is why Martin Marietta recently debuted a newly designed corporate website focused on delivering an improved user experience.


Launched in June, the platform features a sleek, modern look and several upgrades that make the site far easier to navigate. Highlights include an improved Facility Locator with an interactive map, stronger performance on mobile devices, improved visibility and compatibility with AI-powered search tools, richer content and updated operational photography.


Director of Software Engineering Ernie Paschall said company leaders saw an opportunity to strengthen the company's digital presence while better serving visitors.


“Throughout the project, we followed a simple guiding principle of wanting to enhance the site for both speed and clarity. That meant designing a website that feels fast, intuitive and easy to navigate,” Paschall said.“We prioritized the content users see first, heightened images and video for performance, minimized page movement during loading and created a consistent layout across desktop and mobile devices. Just as importantly, we focused every page on a clear purpose so visitors can quickly find the information they need.”


Working with the Raleigh-based firm Gelia, the team vetted concepts and developed the final visual direction.


The group began by studying how visitors interact with Martin Marietta’s online platform across desktop and mobile devices, then used those insights to simplify navigation, reduce intricacy within the code and create a consistent experience regardless of screen size.


“We designed with a mobile-first mindset and cut unnecessary complexity,” Paschall said. “The finished project is a site that better serves users.”


As a result of the changes, many web pages now load dramatically faster than before, helping visitors find information more efficiently.


“High-speed websites are just better to use and make for a more enjoyable experience,” Paschall said. “In our case, some of our pages can now load up to 10 times quicker than they did previously.”


The redesigned site also places greater emphasis on showcasing what makes Martin Marietta successful: its people.


Through authentic photography, team member testimonials and expanded storytelling, the platform highlights the dedication of the company’s ONE team.


“Having spent half of my career in software organizations and the other half at Martin Marietta, I can confidently say I’ve never worked with a more talented, enthusiastic and qualified team,” Paschall said. “This website shows everyone who we are and what we stand for; that is something to be proud of.”


Future enhancements are expected to include AI-powered assistance, online quote requests and expanded product information as Martin Marietta continues to grow.
